claims.statement: Management expects the industrial business and B2B growth trend to continue in the coming year.
claims.quote: I feel that this is a trend which will continue as we go forward in the coming year.

facts.statement: The decorative business added about 3,500 to 4,000 retailers this year, reaching over 1.6 lakh retail outlets.
facts.quote: We have added about 3,500 to 4,000 retailers this year overall, and our reach is now in more than 1.6 lakh retail outlets.

facts.statement: New products contribute about 16% of the company's overall revenues.
facts.quote: today, new product contributes to about 16% of our overall revenues.

facts.statement: The Beautiful Home stores network expands to approximately 74 stores across the country.
facts.quote: Our Beautiful Home stores network, which is doing quite well overall, expands to about 74 stores across the country.

facts.statement: Space decor strategy currently contributes about 4% of decorative revenue.
facts.quote: Right now, obviously it contributes to about 4% of our decorative revenue.
